subject: Logic
title: Circular Reasoning
description: A quick win: understand Circular Reasoning.

hook.text: "The Bible is true because it's God's word, and we know it's God's word because the Bible says so."

buildup.text: Circular reasoning uses the conclusion as one of its own premises. It proves nothing.

discovery.text: It feels convincing because the conclusion keeps reappearing—but no new evidence ever enters.

twist.text: Sophisticated versions disguise the circle with complex language so you don't notice the loop.

climax.text: To catch it, ask: does any premise stand independently of the conclusion? If not, it's circular.

quiz.question: What makes reasoning circular?
options: Using the conclusion as its own evidence
